g.text: Repositories: Symptom · Appointment · Medication · Event · EventRegistration
A write works offline: it lands in Firestore's cache on the phone at once and syncs when online; a write the server's rules refuse is undone, and the app-wide snackbar says so.

A caregiver only sees what is shared: screens showing a patient's data read it through ObserveCareSection, whose ResolveSectionAccess checks the care circle; the security rules check the same on the server.
Arrows are calls: down from one layer to the next, sideways within a layer. Dashed grey boxes are planned. Each feature has its own diagram with its classes.
